factor_changed: advantage sharpness (beta 1.0 -> 0.5 with w_max 3 -> 20, one coupled mechanism)
justification: Both prior candidates learned mostly from failures: iteration 1 had no success, and in iteration 2 the cap held the two successes to 28.6% of the sampling mass while six 3/4 failures carried 54%. Iteration 3 holds iteration 2's rollouts fixed and changes only how sharply AWR concentrates on successes (63% success mass). See amendment A3, including the post-hoc disclosure and the discriminating prediction.
